name: Order summary
description: The cart's subtotal, the store's delivery fee and the total.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/live-order-summary", name: "Order summary", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The cart's subtotal, the store's delivery fee and the total.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(padding: Space.lg, radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Order summary", weight: FontWeight.bold),
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Items (${cart.count})", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(cart.total_cents))]),
      If(condition: store.accepts_delivery, then: Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Delivery", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(store.delivery_fee_cents))])),
      Divider(),
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Total", weight: FontWeight.bold)), Text(child: formatMoney(cart.total_cents + store.delivery_fee_cents), size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold)]),
      Text(child: "The final total is confirmed when you place the order.", size: FontSize.xs, color: Color.textMuted)
    ]))
  )], data: [Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart), Data(name: "store", from: Client.store(), fetch: "client", type: Store)],
)
